name: [X5] +1 Speed Keyboard Escape | Emojis
desc:
🍫 +1 Speed Emoji Keyboard Escape 🍫

🏃 Every step makes you faster!
🌈 Dash across a giant emoji keyboard filled with candy, chocolate, and colorful obstacles.
🔥 Stack insane speed boosts, unlock stronger upgrades, and see how fast you can go.
🏁 Beat parkour stages, race other players, and climb to the top of the leaderboard.
⚠️ One bad jump... and it's back to the beginning!

🎧 Satisfying ASMR Experience
Enjoy smooth movement, clicky keyboard sounds, sweet candy visuals, and relaxing vibes while you speedrun your way to victory. ✨
